name: Fast meme cuts
feel: Loud, quick and self-aware: sub-second cuts, punch-ins, a sound effect on each joke and captions you read at a glance.
transitions: hard cuts, punch-ins and the odd freeze frame; no dissolves
rules: The joke or the payoff is set up in the first second.
A sound effect on each punchline, a little quieter than the voice.
Use only sounds and clips you have the rights to; trending audio is added in the app, not burned in.
Loop it: the last frame should lead back into the first.
